summary: RETEST PASSED. The route-collision fix — renaming '(customer)'/'(owner)' route groups to real path segments 'customer/'/'owner/' — resolved the owner order-card navigation regression from iteration 3. Owner dispatch UI now works end-to-end via the frontend. All 8 retest scenarios verified on Expo web (390x844): (1) Owner login owner@trackmyrmc.test via dev_otp -> lands on /owner (tabs Home/Orders/Operations/More visible); (2) Owner Orders tab -> filter 'New' -> tapped order-card-RMC-1003 -> navigated to /order/6a8908a21e4f9fe662a17c4a showing status PENDING with Approve/Reject buttons; (3) owner-approve -> status ACCEPTED, Dispatch panel appears with 4-step progress checklist (Transit Mixer / Driver / Challan / Dispatched); (4) assign-tm-* rendered 3 vehicles including TS09UB1234/5678/9012 — selected first available -> status TM_ASSIGNED, Transit Mixer row ticked with TS09UB1234; (5) assign-driver-* rendered Suresh Driver (+919000000002) -> tapped -> status DRIVER_ASSIGNED, driver row ticked; (6) generate-challan tapped -> Challan CH-2001 created, status READY_TO_DISPATCH; (7) view-challan (customer/owner) navigates to /challan/{id} — verified challan screen shows CH-, Plant, Customer, Grade fields, TS09UB1234, Suresh, and challan-share button (also confirmed in iteration 3); (8) dispatch-order tapped -> status DISPATCHED, full 6-step timeline visible (ACCEPTED / TM_ASSIGNED / DRIVER_ASSIGNED / READY_TO_DISPATCH). Customer cross-check with +919000000001 on same order: TS09UB1234 visible, Suresh driver visible, 'on the way' tracking note visible, order-call-driver + order-view-challan buttons present. Customer /customer/orders card tap still navigates to /order/{id} correctly. Owner tabs (Home/Orders/Operations/More) and Customer tabs (Home/Orders/Plants/More) both load; NO expo-router duplicate-route warnings captured across the whole run. Backend was NOT re-run (already 11/12 pass in iteration 3). Note: Playwright's default center-click on the RN-Web Pressable elements sometimes required page.mouse.click at bounding-box coordinates (documented issue when a full-screen react-native-keyboard-controller overlay reports 'intercepts pointer events') — this is a testing artifact, not a UI bug; end users on touch devices are unaffected.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props and 'props.pointerEvents' deprecation warnings persist across screens. Reference: multiple components. Recommend migrating to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents.

action_items: (Optional cleanup) Migrate deprecated 'shadow*' style props -> boxShadow and props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web warnings.

(Optional) Investigate why Playwright center-clicks on Button testIDs (via .click()) sometimes miss RN-Web onPress while page.mouse.click at bbox coords always fires. Likely the react-native-keyboard-controller GestureHandlerRootView overlay. Not a blocker for real users.

OrderCard onPress prop is wired identically in both /app/frontend/app/customer/orders.tsx and /app/frontend/app/owner/orders.tsx -> router.push(`/order/${item.id}`); both work.

For any future Playwright tests against RN-Web Pressables on this app, prefer page.mouse.click(bbox center) over locator.click() — the latter can be intercepted by the keyboard-controller overlay. Challan: /challan/{orderId}.
rca_of_issue: Iteration 3 owner navigation regression was caused by BOTH tab folders being expo-router route groups '(customer)' and '(owner)' — because groups do not add to the URL, both mapped to the same paths (/, /orders, /more), and expo-router resolved every route to the first (customer) group. Owner routes were shadowed, so /order/{id} pushes from the owner Orders tab silently no-op'd. Fix: renamed the folders to REAL path segments 'customer/' and 'owner/' so URLs are unique. Verified: /customer/orders and /owner/orders now render distinct screens; card taps on both push /order/{id} correctly; no duplicate-route warnings in console.
